missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Кофе' is an indeclinable masculine noun in the nominative. 'Этот' and 'горячий' are masculine, confirming the gender despite the fixed form.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Кофе' is the accusative object of 'пью' but stays indeclinable. 'Каждое утро' is the accusative time phrase.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В кофе' uses the preposition 'в' to locate the contents, though 'кофе' does not change form. 'Сахара' is genitive after 'много'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Кофе' is the genitive after 'нет', identical in form because the word is indeclinable. The frame shows there is none today.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'От кофе' takes the genitive after 'от' to mean refusing the coffee, with the form unchanged. 'Вечером' is the instrumental time word.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В кофе' uses the accusative after 'в' to show adding into the coffee. 'Молоко' is the accusative object of 'добавил'.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Благодаря кофе' uses the dative after 'благодаря', with the form fixed. The clause explains why the speaker stays awake.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Кофе' is the instrumental required by 'наслаждаюсь', unchanged in form. 'Утренним' is the masculine instrumental adjective marking the case.
Strategic focus: Counting an indeclinable noun. 'Кофе' follows 'два' but cannot change form, so the number alone signals quantity. A common everyday order at a counter.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Кофе' is the accusative object of 'готовят', indeclinable as always. 'Прекрасный' is the masculine adjective, and 'здесь' gives the place.
